summary: Requirements re-read on the stable tree returned one finding, the hard-overflow edge, settled fail closed by the owner. The owner also confirmed the story stays a single task and queued both follow-ups on the roadmap.
gaps: The 'no grant hidden' promise had no behaviour for the case where even the compact name-and-id list exceeds the total prompt budget, so truncation there would violate the spec's own guarantee.
resolutions: Owner ruled fail closed: the spec and plan now state that when the compact list cannot fit, the run fails before any provider or tool call with a redacted capability_catalog_overflow startup diagnostic naming the granted and renderable counts, and acceptance criterion 4b asserts it.
open_items: Owner queued the document edit spec on the roadmap as follow-up; it currently exists only as a superseded draft.
Owner queued the second runtime's catalog on the roadmap as follow-up; this story asserts its absence so the gap cannot drift silently.
